diagnosis: The banking BFF controller extracts the X-Customer-Id header from the incoming client request and passes it directly to the downstream CoreBankingFeignClient without verifying that the customer ID matches the authenticated JWT principal. Downstream core banking microservices blindly trust the propagated header, enabling attackers to authorize wire disbursements from foreign customer accounts.
